translations.web: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
translations.bsb: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
translations.kjv: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
translations.asv: For Jehovah heareth the needy, And despiseth not his prisoners.
